svg.title: CTB-025 COMPACT sheet 440x620 of remaining 15 birch6 parts without P06_BONDED on single 440x800 sheet
svg.desc: DESIGN_ONLY, physical kerf and assembly unverified. Only CUT_OUTER and CUT_INNER paths; no board-reference perimeter. Additional already cut: P06_BONDED. Assumed already cut: P04L/P04U/P07T/P07B, L1_S1..S4, L2_S1..S4, L3_P01_1 and L3_P01_2.
